'''''Mathematische Zeitschrift''''' ([[German language|German]] for ''Mathematical Journal'') is a [[mathematical journal]] for pure and applied mathematics published by [[Springer Verlag]].

==History==
The journal was founded in 1917, with its first issue appearing in 1918. It was initially edited by [[Leon Lichtenstein]] together with [[Konrad Knopp]], [[Erhard Schmidt]], and [[Issai Schur]].<ref name=LL>{{mactutor|title=Leon Lichtenstein|id=Lichtenstein}}</ref> Because Lichtenstein was Jewish, he was forced to step down as editor in 1933 under the [[Nazi Germany|Nazi rule of Germany]];<ref name=crelle/> he fled to Poland and died soon after.<ref name=LL/> The editorship was offered to [[Helmut Hasse]], but he refused,<ref name=crelle>{{cite journal
 | last = Rohrbach | first = Hans
 | doi = 10.1515/crll.1998.070
 | journal = Journal für die Reine und Angewandte Mathematik
 | mr = 1637469
 | pages = 5–13
 | title = Helmut Hasse and Crelle's journal
 | volume = 500
 | year = 1998}} Translated by Bärbel Deninger from the 1982 German original.</ref> and [[Konrad Knopp]] took it over. Other past editors include [[Erich Kamke]], [[Friedrich Karl Schmidt]], [[Rolf Nevanlinna]], [[Helmut Wielandt]], and [[Olivier Debarre]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://link.springer.com/journal/209/editorial-board|title=Editorial board|work=Mathematische Zeitschrift (publisher web site)|publisher=Springer|access-date=2024-10-21}}</ref>
